sources.title: ananddey/akhorika-e2b-base · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Akhorika E2B Base (আখৰিকা) is a foundational 2.69B parameter language model (1.91B active text decoder parameters) continued-pretrained (CPT) on Assamese language corpora based on Google's Gemma 4 E2B architecture.

sources.snippet: E2B is an open-source infrastructure that allows you to run AI-generated code in secure isolated sandboxes in the cloud. To start and control sandboxes, use our JavaScript SDK or Python SDK.
